title: Electricity prices now use a rolling 12-month average
body: State electricity prices now use EIA's residential average for September 2025 – August 2026 (12 months), total revenue divided by total sales, replacing the January-August 2026 figure.

source.title: U.S. EIA, Form EIA-861M: Sales and revenue data by state, monthly (sales_revenue.xlsx)
source.note: Data statuses in window: Final, Preliminary. File: https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia861m/xls/sales_revenue.xlsx
